reviews.title: Scam
reviews.text: I purchased this app 3 months ago for 98$ for the year. Now it only lets me make 10 invoices a month or I have to upgrade for another 300$ to the unlimited. The app advertises the pro as unlimited. Customer support is not helpful, they say it’s only unlimited for 98$ if you buy it from their website. But because I bought thru apple App Store it an extra 300. Total rip off.

reviews.title: Great if you have no employees
reviews.text:
This app is fantastic until you have employees that you need to share information with.
It is literally hoop after hoop to jump through to try to get somebody else signed in where they can get invoices and edit them. Verification codes that never come through. QR codes to scan. What the heck man how about just a link to click on and let somebody join

reviews.title: This app won’t save us from ourselves
reviews.text: Are there any good designers left in the world? I’m a first time user who spent hours crunching numbers on 2-page invoice between doing loads of laundry. Was choosing template & finishing touches when phone battery took a dump. Low battery alarm didn’t go off because I accidentally muted with slider in upper left corner of my old iPhone. I gave this 1-star because of course I lost everything. How difficult would it be for system to auto-save thus keep this horrible situation from happening? Also not happy because it was advertised as free & then after download we figure out that it’s only a free 3-day trial. Appears to be a nice app but it made me really angry that they want money but force us to manually click save or risk getting the shaft!

reviews.title: Invoice fly stole my $105
reviews.text: Invoice fly stole my money I had put the wrong card and I canceled my subscription I didn’t have funds in that account so it declined so then I went on my setting and canceled the app and subscription and then I had gotten my check and boom when I least expected my money gone I had payments to do and this really put in a tight situation I dont know what to do I don’t recommend this app at all please don’t waste your money on scammers it makes our world harder to be in

reviews.title: Absolute rip off
reviews.text: Been using the app for 2 years purely for invoices. I’ve paid £11.00 a month. They’ve now upped their prices to £17.99. Over a 54% increase. I complained and they justified it by saying they’ve added a load of product of which I don’t use? Why am I being forced to pay for things I don’t use. They should keep a basic plan for people who only use the app for the bare minimum.

reviews.title: Doesn’t do what it claims
reviews.text:
I went through the whole sign up, agreed to the free trail.  Was excited to try out this estimate based off of the photos and I could not for the life of me find anything of the sort.  Only place I could even add photo was as an attachment to the invoice/estimate.  
I’m so disappointed because this would have been a game changer for my cleaning business.  
I do like the fact it gives you a break down of all things related to cleaning a place but there was no where to enter any information as to what size this Mock place was, it’s got a great concept going just needs bells and whistles polished up some more

reviews.title: Way too expensive
reviews.text: The app works fine, but £8.99 per week is way too expensive! I’ve only done two small jobs a week apart — one was just re-siliconing, the other repainting a bathroom — yet I had to pay £17.98. As a self-employed person, work comes and goes, so a weekly subscription just doesn’t work. I can’t manage the yearly subscription either. They really need a more flexible pricing option for people like me.

reviews.title: Invoice maker
reviews.text: NOT FREE!!!!

reviews.title: Headline Does not update
reviews.text: Overall, very happy with the app, but the biggest problem that we are having is when an estimate is converted over to an invoice it does not match the headline. For example, if I do an estimate for a Tesla charger and then I invoice that Tesla charger whatever invoice I did prior or previously is the headline that is put on the invoice and it causes great confusion with the customers making them think they got something different than what was installed, and you have to manually change it all the time and it is very time-consuming and frustrating when you have multiple invoices to keep track of for multiple customers that is the only reason I would give it one star. Time is money.

reviews.title: Owner
reviews.text:
I had this invoice maker app for years, it worked great and then it didn't, I asked for help because the print was too light to see and no one could help me, so October 15, 2025 I deleted the app
Update !!!!!!
I submitted this review in October 2024, I just got a reply from the people who own this app and control it on this day January 19, 2026!
Three months is how long it took for them to reply to the problem I was having ! Can you go three months without sending out an invoice? No you can't
They can kissmyass
Today's date is Thursday, January 22, 2026, I'm trying to do an invoice right now and it's not working! It won't let me add the materials to the total, it insist on me using the materials from another job! I'm ready to give up, it seems like all they want is me to give them $100

reviews.title: So Bland, and buggy!
reviews.text: So I have been using this app for about 2 1/2 years. Obviously there is no perfect app, But today was my boiling point. I have lost many(countless) estimates I spent hours writing up, then when I clicked save, an error popped up saying (something went wrong try again) I have learned don’t close this window because on the app on my phone it never updated. I have lost countless hours due to this app. Unfortunately I am looking for a new solution and trust me steer faaaaaarrr away from this app. It’s got nothing special.

reviews.title: Don’t bother, use a different app
reviews.text: Downloaded made an invoice and the app just constantly loads for ages so you can’t do anything with the invoice or send it anywhere and you can’t screenshot the screen is just black. Absolute rubbish wasted 15 minutes of my life and I’ll delete it now… don’t bother
